description_en: Submit a real-person video clip to generate a corresponding 2D digital human avatar. This API returns an avatar code immediately. You can later use this code to call APIs that query, update, or delete the avatar
description_zh: 提交一段真人视频素材生成对应的2D真人数字人形象，该接口会立即返回一个形象code，后续可以根据形象code调用查询、更新、删除人物接口
kebab_example: aliyun avatar create-2d-avatar --tenant-id 1 --name '博远' --portrait https://virtual-human-assets.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/2d_assets/xxx/xxx/xxx.png0Expires=xxx_OSSAccessKeyId=xxx_Signature=xxx --video https://virtual-human-assets.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/2d_assets/xxx/xxx/xxx.mov0Expires=xxx_OSSAccessKeyId=xxx_Signature=xxx --transparent true --orientation 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: Create2dAvatar

parameters.help_en: TenantId obtained from the digitized virtual human Open Platform
parameters.help_zh: 从虚拟数字人开放平台中获取的TenantId
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.example: 朝气蓬勃，富有感染力，适用于播音、传媒广电、企业宣传等场景
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
Thumbnail URL for the avatar.

If not provided, the first frame of the video will be used as the thumbnail.

If provided, it must match the original video resolution, use PNG format, and be smaller than 10 MB
parameters.help_zh:
人物缩略图URL。

如果不传，将会截取视频第一帧作为人物缩略图。
如果传，要求分辨率和原视频分辨率保持一致，格式png，大小<10M
parameters.name: image

parameters.help_en:
Profile picture URL for the avatar.

Requirements: 1:1 aspect ratio, PNG format, and smaller than 10 MB
parameters.help_zh:
人物头像URL。
要求：尺寸1:1，格式png，大小<10M
parameters.name: portrait

parameters.help_en:
URL of the original video footage. Requirements:

Format: MOV, WebM, or MP4. Use WebM for transparent videos.

Duration: 5–10 minutes

Resolution: 1080p

Size: smaller than 10 GB
parameters.help_zh:
原始视频素材URL，要求：

格式mov、webm、mp4，针对透明视频格式推荐webm
视频时长5-10分钟
分辨率1080p
大小<10G
parameters.name: video

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether the original video footage has a transparent background.

true: Transparent format. Supports background replacement.

false: Opaque format. Does not support background replacement
parameters.help_zh:
原始视频素材是否是透明

true：透明格式，可支持替换背景
false：非透明格式，不支持替换背景
parameters.name: transparent

parameters.help_en:
Video orientation: portrait or landscape.

1: Portrait

2: Landscape
parameters.help_zh:
原始视频方向：横竖屏

1: 竖屏
2: 横屏
parameters.name: orientation

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to send a callback event when the 2D avatar generation task succeeds or fails. Default is false (no callback). For more information, see Digital human callback event notifications (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2261152.html?spm=a2c4g.447644.0.0.406f5876hRJTVU)
parameters.help_zh: 本次2D形象生成任务成功或失败是否需要事件回调，默认false不回调。具体可参考文档：数字人回调事件通知 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2261152.html?spm=a2c4g.447644.0.0.406f5876hRJTVU)
parameters.name: callback
